_doc: Converted CE maps tools/level/upgrade_ce_map.py takes through the B30 pipeline. conversion: the map's convert_ce_map.sh output (level file, sbsp, staging/placement.json); scene: the folder whose scene.gltf and materials.spec.json the landscape and foliage are baked from (the conversion when omitted); shaders: the ground shaders' name substrings (build_landscape --shader); landscape: the editor world's code (/Game/Levels/Halo1/Solo/<code>/<code>) and chunk; details: protected detail bitmaps by class (scatter_foliage --detail); water: parameters for the level's ocean; rivers: {textures: texture-name tokens of CE flowing-water slots, spec: their M_CE_Ocean parameters}; waterfalls: {hide: texture-name tokens of the CE waterfall cards to hide, falls: MJOLNIRLevelLoader Effects.waterfalls entries}; cliff_uv: the cliffs drawn by a flat copy with even UVs, cm a UV unit (cliff_mesh.py --conformal: Sidewinder's CE cliff UVs run 3 to 13 times further along than up, which no tiling undoes); cliff_shaders: the cliff shaders by name when their detail maps do not say so (exact slots); cliff_scalars: the shipped cliff material's own parameters ("Name#k" for layer k's; Sidewinder's "Tile U#0"/"Tile V#0", the glacial rock's base layer: its CE cliff UVs span 92 m across to 26 m up, so the glacial rock tiled 4x squashed; Ice Fields' span about 70 m both ways, which the defaults suit); real_base: bake plain ground's own CE base colour (its pbr.ice reads it); ground_looks: some ground shaders' own material parameters (vectors, scalars) over the ground's (Ice Fields' ice caves: all ice, no steep rock, no fill, which unshadowed lit the tunnels white, never cut by the landscape); ground_also: shaders drawn in the ground's look on the mesh but not part of the landscape; weather: "snow" adds the game's falling snow, kept out from under roofs (gen_ce_level.weather_roofs); biome: "snow" dresses the map from B40 (glacial rocks, snow-packed firs, snowy stones; scenery_swap.py and scatter_foliage.py --biome) instead of B30; haze: "ce" makes the landscape's height fog the map's own CE atmospheric fog, over every surface (upgrade_ce_map.ce_haze); tints: foliage rule tints (scatter_foliage --rule-tint); rocks: beach (B30's Uluwatu, the default) or desert boulders for swapped CE rocks; base_level: the level file to build on when it is not the conversion's own (the separate water mesh and ocean settings of 2026-10-11 live only in the installed files, snapshotted); environment: merged into the level's environment (skylight.lower: the ground's bounce colour; clouds: volumetric clouds); mesh_container: a mesh container (.utoc/.ucas stem) to install over the hub copy's (the separate water mesh of 2026-10-11); hub: the hub slug the install replaces; components: landscape components a side when the default does not suit.
